title: Bus Capacity Tracking System
summary: As design and manufacturing lead, I helped build an Arduino-driven infrared sensing system that counts riders as they board and shows the bus's occupancy on a display.
result: Reached 98% detection accuracy through structured verification testing, and won the section best project award.
role: Design and manufacturing lead on a team project for GEEN 1400 Engineering Projects
spec: Track how full a bus is as riders board, and show the occupancy where people can see it.
Infrared emitters and receivers at the door count riders, an Arduino-based transmitter tracks the total, and an LED display shows the current occupancy.
I modeled the transmitter and display housings in SolidWorks Sheet Metal, made detailed drawings, and prepared manufacturable designs in CorelDRAW.
98% detection accuracy, with detection error reduced below 2% through iterative electrical and mechanical design changes. Section best project award.
Arduino, IR sensors, SolidWorks Sheet Metal, CorelDRAW
